mechanism.candidate: All ten source-neutral choices of two among five public 4-bit causal registers tested, fully learned four degree<=4 polynomial functions over eight source/input bits (163 bit-monomials per output), each with zero FIT errors and complexity tie-breaking. Packed incremental GF2 elimination and training-time bit-parallel compilation of complete 256-pair truth function, exact eight-event role-state recurrence.
mechanism.equal_control: Independent full Gauss-Jordan fit using exactly the same 163 monomials, full ten pair registers, same public 192 causal FIT events, same minimum-coefficients and degree ties, optimized native full 256-entry compiled truth table.
mechanism.historical_secondary: Original fully optimized bitwise ANF from F124-DD, with fresh additional meta-task data; restricted bitwise source class and not a fair peer for novel cross-bit operators.
mechanism.disclosed_known_hypothesis: Both primary learners are supplied the complete generic degree<=4 Boolean polynomial prior over exactly two 4-bit input registers; arithmetic operator identity/wiring is not given. The synthetic source-side carry law is representable in that prior. This is not unbounded structural program discovery.

interpretation.carry: New source-neutral learned cross-bit representation reconstructs modular addition carry from 24 FIT episodes and transfers on all four new cases; optimized independent full-ANF control matches accuracy. Candidate observed complete CPU 13.7% lower, RSS 0.06% lower on sourcefree carry family. Not independently replicated external scientific source and internal FLOPs not matched.
interpretation.rotate: Both primary models naturally FIT each of four rotation-after-add task cases, but only two pass all eight CHECK veto episodes. Although diagnostics show 25 of 32 total positive trajectories exact, only 16/32 can count under natural admission. Complete CPU is lower but RAM marginally higher, and frozen resource/correctness gate FAIL.
interpretation.source_identifiability: For 4-bit inputs there are 256 possible pairs; 24x8 FIT rows can reveal at most 192 and empirically at most 137.5 average distinct visible pairs across each unknown pair candidate on carry sources. An unconstrained pairwise mapping remains unidentifiable from the public FIT alone; correct transfer relies on disclosed degree<=4 polynomial prior, not unconstrained discovery.
interpretation.carry_negative: The three-register arithmetic negative does not fit any pairwise degree<=4 model; none of the natural unfit models may claim holdout performance or zero hard error rate.
interpretation.strong_control: Both primary algorithms are equally informed in sourcefree FIT and full 163-term hypothesis; the candidate's measured CPU improvement is an implementation optimization. Same number of public event updates and heldout calls is not a native-FLOP equality audit. Historical restricted bitwise arm is not fairness evidence.
